laws.rule: A state of emergency is in effect for Lima and Callao (reported as in force since October 2025). Armed forces are sometimes seen on the streets. Under a Peruvian state of emergency, movement can be restricted, curfews set and searches and detentions carried out. Declarations are published in the official gazette, El Peruano.
